name: The Man Who Still Commutes
idea: He retired years ago and still walks this passage every morning, out of habit. He notices everything.

say: "Forty-one years I walked this way to work. Then I stopped working. I didn't stop walking."
"Looking for things people dropped? I see everything."
A bench worn pale at one end, where the same person has sat for years.
A pillar with a scuff at shoulder height, where ten thousand bags have brushed past.
"This is where I change floors," he said. "Same spot, forty-one years."
